messages:
anika: FYI CI is failing on the audit-event validator for RBAC-change events — only happening on private deploy tests :confused:
kyle: repro steps? which assertion is tripping?
anika: when the test posts the admin.role_change event, validator errors with mismatch on envelope.nonce and envelope.version
anika: sample from CI failure:
```
- expected.envelope.version: "v1"
- actual.envelope.version: "v2"
- expected.envelope.nonce: "fixed-123"
- actual.envelope.nonce: "rnd-7a3b"
```

olivia: hmm, v2 came from the new KMS shim we deployed to private. It adds a per-encryption nonce to support AEAD rotation — intentionally nondeterministic.
maya: so our golden fixtures assume deterministic envelope fields, which breaks when the private shim injects random nonces. CI was strict equality.
kyle: two options: (1) canonicalize envelopes before comparison (drop nonce/version) or (2) make golden fixtures include a regex for envelope fields. Which is less risky?
olivia: canonicalization sounds safer long-term. Validator can strip these runtime-only fields before comparing against golden set. Also add a shallow schema rule that envelope.{nonce,ephemeral_key} are ignored for equality checks.
maya: agree. quick patch: update the validator to run a normalizer step that removes envelope.nonce and envelope.ephemeral_key when source=="private" or when a flag is set. Then update CI to set that flag for private tests.
anika: note: some customers read envelope.version for tooling; we can't always drop it universally. We should only ignore it in equality checks, not remove it from logs.
kyle: good catch. So validator: keep full event for storage/telemetry, but for golden-comparison use a normalized copy with non-deterministic fields scrubbed.
sec-bot: CI link: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/validators/8823 — failing jobs: private-infra-e2e, golden-compare. Attached artifact: /artifacts/8823/audit-fail.json
sre-oncall: any customer-facing impact? Is prod emitting different envelopes now?
olivia: production behavior unchanged for hosted; private deploys intentionally changed. Only private tests are failing. No customer-facing regression for hosted. But customers on private may see the nonce present — intended.
maya: plan: 1) patch validator normalizer (PR in eng-security repo), 2) add unit test that injects randomized nonce, 3) update golden fixtures or annotate them to reflect immutable vs ephemeral fields, 4) backfill a short doc in compliance-runbook about which envelope fields are allowed to vary.
kyle: owner? we can triage and patch today and cut a hotfix to the validator image used in CI. Put a short-lived skip for golden-compare on private tests if needed.
anika: I'll own the PR and the doc. Will also add a CI job that verifies validator normalizer doesn't drop customer-visible fields (random property-based tests).
olivia: I'll coordinate with infra to roll the patched validator image to the CI workers.
maya: timeline?
anika: PR by EOD, tests by tomorrow morning, CI image build midday. If green, revert golden-compare skip and close the incident.
sre-oncall: please post progress here. If we need to hotfix customer infra, ping oncall early.
kyle: also add a small note in the audit-schema README explaining that envelope.nonce is expected to be nondeterministic for certain KMS configurations. Saves future confusion.
anika: will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
